## File: open-webui_openapi-servers/servers/google-pse/main.py

Prompts

```
['run the FastAPI server that exposes Google Programmable Search Engine web search and health check endpoints', 'perform a web search using Google Custom Search API with optional language, country, date, and file type filters', 'perform a paginated web search by specifying the start index and number of results to return', 'perform a web search restricted to a specific site using the siteSearch and siteSearchFilter parameters', 'check the health status of the Google Programmable Search Engine FastAPI service']
```

Usage

```
{'run_google_pse_server': 'run the FastAPI server that exposes Google Programmable Search Engine web search and health check endpoints', 'search_web_with_filters': 'perform a web search using Google Custom Search API with optional language, country, date, and file type filters', 'search_web_pagination': 'perform a paginated web search by specifying the start index and number of results to return', 'search_web_site_restriction': 'perform a web search restricted to a specific site using the siteSearch and siteSearchFilter parameters', 'health_check_google_pse': 'check the health status of the Google Programmable Search Engine FastAPI service'}
```
